_readme: EDIT THESE VALUES. Paste your advertisement code (AdSense, Adsterra, etc.) into the slot fields below as RAW HTML/JavaScript. Leave a slot empty ("") to disable it. The code is inserted verbatim into every generated page - it is never modified or escaped by the build system. DO NOT add secrets here if your ad provider does not require them client-side.

_placement_reference.top: Above the page title / below the main navigation
_placement_reference.after_intro: After the API description and info table (also used on homepage after hero)
_placement_reference.before_related: Just above the Related APIs section
_placement_reference.sidebar: Reserved (responsive layouts may ignore this slot)
